snippet.title: Poolcore Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251780/Poolcore/

Poolcore is a first-person walking simulator traversing through dreamlike poolrooms. 
You have fallen into this world and now you must observe if these ancient waters and walls have sentient traits. 
Explore/wander and solve puzzles to progress.

Discord: https://discord.gg/jCsPgmdWnk
Website: https://galacticthumb.com
Release Date: TBA
Game Soundtrack: zerofuturism
Trailer Music: i2pt6 - 7c
